title: Lazy Sunday Saudi Arabian Lamb Tagine
description: A nutty and flaky Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb, buttermilk, and slow-cooked spices, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This recipe is onion and garlic free, making it suitable for those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the browned lamb to the bowl and toss to coat with the buttermilk mixture.
Add the dried apricots to the bowl and toss to combine.
Transfer the lamb and apricot mixture to the Dutch oven.
Cover the Dutch oven with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the Dutch oven from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the lamb tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
